highlights: Choose a mascot for the app icon in Settings > General > App icon. The Dock or taskbar icon shows it in your logo color.
Sync Jira issues into the Tickets board. Connect Atlassian in the Marketplace, then pick a Jira project in Sync tickets.
Skip the Architect, Reviewer or Quality role for an easy ticket. The Raven team page warns you first.
Pick Chrome, Brave, Firefox or Edge for external links in Settings > General. Chat links open in the OpenBot browser.
Ask an agent to create a channel or start its own threads. Threads now sit in the chat header.
